verdict.rationale: Column's own guides index says it offers KYC/KYB verifications with manual-review support, so the product does provide the core capability for both individuals and businesses. The evidence is a single thin mention and does not show how verification is driven through the API. missing for 10: documented programmatic KYC/KYB API endpoints, document collection, watchlist/sanctions screening, explicitly modeled application/verification states, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, customer verification is programmatic — KYC for individuals and KYB for businesses with document collection, watchlist screening, and clearly modeled application states

citations.quote: Bring your own KYC/KYB process, or use our KYC/KYB verifications with support for manual reviewing.
